# GDW Mirror

> Espejo de pantalla entre macOS y Windows por red local, en cualquier dirección pero un sentido a la vez. Una sola aplicación dual permite compartir la pantalla local o abrir el visor remoto desde la barra de estado o la bandeja. Sin control remoto, drivers, servicios, nube ni cuentas. / Screen mirroring between macOS and Windows over the local network, in either direction but one way at a time. One dual-role app lets you share the local screen or open the remote viewer from the menu bar or system tray. No remote control, drivers, services, cloud, or accounts. By José Cruz Chávez.

- [README.md](README.md): Documentación completa en español.
- [README.en.md](README.en.md): Full documentation in English.
- [LICENSE](LICENSE): Proprietary; personal consultation and use only.
- [package.json](package.json): Project metadata, npm scripts, keywords.
- [builder/dual.yml](builder/dual.yml): Packaging configuration for macOS and Windows dual app.

## Source code

- [src/main.js](src/main.js): Entry point for the default host/tray role.
- [src/entry-dual.js](src/entry-dual.js): Packaged dual-app entry point.
- [src/host-main.js](src/host-main.js): System tray, panel, HTTP signaling, LAN discovery, and share/view actions.
- [src/host.js](src/host.js): Screen capture engine and WebRTC.
- [src/menu.js](src/menu.js): Tray popover with sharing and remote-viewer controls.
- [src/viewer-main.js](src/viewer-main.js): Remote viewer window, discovery, and network IPC.
- [src/viewer.js](src/viewer.js): Connection UI and playback.
- [src/icons.js](src/icons.js): Tray and app icons.
- [src/fit.js](src/fit.js): Window aspect-ratio fitting calculation.
- [src/net.js](src/net.js): HTTP client and network utilities.

## Key facts

- Architecture: Electron, WebRTC (DTLS-SRTP transport), ScreenCaptureKit capture on macOS, H.264 encoding.
- Transport: HTTP signaling on LAN + WebRTC P2P media. No relay servers or telemetry.
- Quality profiles: Sharp (30 fps, 60 Mbps), Smooth (60 fps, 80 Mbps), High (90 fps, 100 Mbps), Eco (30 fps, 12 Mbps).
- Requirements: macOS 13 Ventura+ (Apple Silicon or Intel), Windows 10/11 x64, same LAN.
- Security: pairing code off by default; 8 failures from one IP block for 30 seconds when enabled.
- Distribution: GitHub Releases (macOS ZIP/DMG and Windows installer/portable app).

## CI/CD

- [.github/workflows/release.yml](.github/workflows/release.yml): Builds the dual app for macOS (arm64 + x64) and Windows, computes SHA-256, and publishes GitHub Releases on tag push.
- [.github/workflows/build-msix.yml](.github/workflows/build-msix.yml): Manual build of the Windows dual app installer and portable executable.
